page.overview:
Who is Constantine Corrino?

Lord Constantine Corrino was the illegitimate son of Emperor Javicco Corrino who was torn between seeking his father's approval and his own happiness.

The illegitimate son of Emperor Corrino, Constantine is torn between seeking his father's approval and indulging his own vices.

As a child, Constantine was with his sister when rebels came in to kidnap her. Constantine knew he couldn't stop them, so he told them to take him as well. Their parents covered this up in order to avoid looking weak and even as an adult, Constantine refused to talk about it.

After Constantine's sister, Ynez, was betrothed to Pruwet Richese, Constantine visited Wallach IX to make arrangements for Ynez to train there with the Sisterhood. He wanted her to have private accommodations, but accepted it when Valya said she would be treated the same as any other student once she arrived. Constantine then returned to Salusa Secondus and told Ynez about the arrangements he had made.
